svg.metadata: {"id": "s045", "name": "气象站", "cat": "科学", "tags": ["科学", "天气", "气象观测", "地理"], "desc": "户外气象观测场：白色百叶箱、风速风向杆（风杯与风向标）、雨量筒、日照计、风向袋与升空的探空气球。", "stand": {"ground_y": 880, "x": [600, 1300]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "rainbow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.25, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "hills", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "ground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "fence", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "screen_box", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "mast", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "vane", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "instruments", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "windsock_pole", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "windsock", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "balloon", "enter": "rise", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#86CCF0", "sky2": "#E9F7FF", "sun": "#FFD36E", "hill": "#B3DCA2", "hill2": "#97CD86", "grass1": "#A3D486", "grass2": "#83C26A", "plot": "#C3E6A8", "white": "#FFFFFF", "white2": "#E1E7EE", "white3": "#C7D0DA", "metal": "#7D8A98", "metal2": "#A9B4C0", "red": "#F2735E", "orange": "#F7A64A", "fence": "#FFFFFF", "path": "#EBDDBE", "panel": "#3D5B8C", "panel2": "#6C90C6", "blue": "#5FB7D6", "tree": "#5FAE74", "tree2": "#9AD48B", "trunk": "#8A5A3A", "rainbow1": "#F7A6A0", "rainbow2": "#FFE08A", "rainbow3": "#A8E0B5", "rainbow4": "#9FD3F5"}}
